# appleads_app (Data Source)

Resolves an App Store app to the Adam ID and related identifiers required when creating Apple Ads campaigns.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appleads_app" "example" {
  name = "OrbitNote"
}

output "adam_id" {
  value = data.appleads_app.example.adam_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Adam ID (App Store identifier) of the app. Exactly one of `name` or `id` must be set as input; always populated in the result.
- `name` (String) App Store display name to look up. Exactly one of `name` or `id` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `adam_id` (String) Adam ID of the resolved app (same value as `id`).
- `country_or_region` (String) Country or region associated with the app listing when returned by Apple Ads.
- `developer_name` (String) Developer name returned by Apple Ads for the app.
